title: Plone Site
description: The site root. Editable in Volto like any other content — it carries a title, a description and blocks — but it is NOT a dexterity content type, so it has none of the behaviours schema-base.json describes: no publication dates, no short name, and nothing to exclude from a navigation it IS the root of. `mergeBase: false` says so.
